next_step: Send short privacy/retention FAQ + sample policy; confirm auto-delete window and opt-out hooks; schedule 30-min technical call
notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup + inbound contact via site chat. Small KM startup building a lightweight support-bot for SMB customers.

Initial contact (2026-03-02): signed up sandbox on hosted API. AE reachout same day; prospect asked detailed privacy questions.

Key quotes/fragments noted: "Do you store prompts by default? Can users opt-out / request deletion?" 
"We can't keep transcripts longer than 7 days for some clients. Need proof of deletion."

What they told us:
- Multi-tenant SaaS, handles support transcripts and internal knowledge articles (~3k docs used in eval)
- Currently using serverless app + Firebase; want hosted API to avoid self-host ops
- Strong desire to not retain PII in logs; prefer redwood "no-prompt-retention" or auto-delete options
- Interested in embeddings for doc search first, then summarization for agents; chat for escalation next quarter

Technical/ops asks:
- Default log retention length and ability to set shorter retention per org
- Opt-out API: ability for end-user to exclude their session/prompt from analytics/retention (GDPR-ish flow)
- Whether prompts are stored in plaintext or encrypted at rest, and whether KMS is available for hosted logs
- Can we provide deletion webhook/confirmation for completed deletion requests?
- Residency: prefer NA; asked how long backups are retained

Security/Compliance:
- Not enterprise, but legal team requests simple retention SLA and an audit log for deletes
- Requested SOC2 checklist and quick answers doc (we provided drive link)
- No SAML required for now; might add SSO later

Evaluation activities so far:
- 2026-03-05 demo with SE (Elliot). Ran basic embeddings on 3k-doc corpus; latency fine, token cost higher than expected.
- Proof-of-concept: sandbox app made 1k calls/day during test window (approx. 40k tokens/day).
- Raised ticket INF-3421 asking for sample retention policy and delete confirmation flow.

Notes from SE call:
- Elliot outlined Hosted API default retention (30 days) and the available short-retention toggle for SMB plans (7 days) — prospect wants 7 by default.
- Discussed opt-out flag that prevents logs from being ingested into analytics and prevents caching of prompt contexts. Prospect: "We need this to reassure enterprise customers."

Follow-ups completed:
- Sent hosted-api retention FAQ and a short policy template (drive link).
- Shared SOC2 high-level slide deck.
- Logged INF-3421 to coordinate sample webhook for deletion confirmation.

Open items / Next call agenda:
- Confirm whether 7-day auto-delete can be defaulted on their account; provide implementation notes for opt-out param.
- Provide language for their privacy policy regarding "we do not store prompts after deletion request" and expected latency for deletions.
- Quick pricing note: want to keep monthly spend < $500; discuss token-optimizations and Optimize suggestions.

Sales cues: small ARR but fast pilot velocity; high chance to convert to paid if retention/opt-out story is airtight.
